$comment: Summarizer-bench fixture: hand-assembled parent excerpts for the cheap-role ingest summarizers (quran-llm.ts surahSummarizer / hadith-llm.ts hadithSectionSummarizer, wired by scripts/ingest-quran.mjs and scripts/ingest-hadith.mjs). Production feeds the summarizer parent.children's Arabic primary text (rag-ingest pipeline: childTexts = textPrimary), so every excerpt here is Arabic primary text only — Quran ayahs verbatim from the Tanzil Uthmani edition via the hangsbreaker/quran-json mirror (fetched 2026-11-13, verbatim distribution permitted with attribution to tanzil.net), hadith Arabic from fawazahmed0/hadith-api (The Unlicense) reusing the decision fixture's committed passages. Indonesian and English Quran translation wording is deliberately NOT used (Kemenag licensing gate). The gate scores what is deterministic — format bounds (the prompt's own 1-3 sentence rule) and faithfulness (Arabic-script tokens and numerals in the summary must ground in the excerpt, title, or source key; token normalization strips tashkeel and unifies alef forms) — and the report prints every summary so theme quality stays the owner's human call. Source keys mirror the editions' numbering for prompt context; the fixture stays v0-draft until the owner signs the content off.

cases.title: كِتَاب بَدْءِ الْوَحْي
excerpt: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى دُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ

سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ، قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، يَقُولُ : " إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى دُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ

cases.title: كِتَاب الطَّهَار
excerpt: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضى الله عنها وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ فِي الْيَوْمِ الشَّدِيدِ الْبَرْدِ، فَيَفْصِمُ عَنْهُ وَإِنَّ جَبِينَهُ لَيَتَفَصَّدُ عَرَقًا
